items.title: Russian Military Slang Reveals the Reality of Life on the Front Line
items.description: A 250-page study of almost 7,000 communications between Russian military personnel and their relatives in 2025 illustrated the reality of life in the combat zone for those fed into the “meat grinder” that is Putin’s “special military operation.”

items.title: Russia's Putin arrives in India as BRICS leaders begin talks
items.description: President Putin arrived as talks among leaders of the BRICS diplomatic bloc began on Friday in India, amid global geopolitical turmoil, including the war in Ukraine and the conflict in the Middle East.

items.title: Isolated by Iran and Yemeni Houthi rebels, Saudi Arabia seeks US backing
items.description: With Tehran-allied rebels seizing control of the Bab al-Mandab Strait between the Red Sea and the Indian Ocean on Thursday, and Iran blocking the Strait of Hormuz, the kingdom is at risk of losing all maritime access for its oil tankers.

items.title: The other side of 9/11: Afghans reckon with America's long shadow
items.description: It's been nearly 25 years since the start of the U.S- led invasion of Afghanistan. NPR returns to Kabul to see how Afghans, now back under Taliban rule, are coping with the legacy of that 20 year war.

items.title: Lightning Houthi advance in Yemen may bring dangerous new dimension to Iran war
items.description: The capture by the rebels of a stretch of Yemen's strategic coastline is the group's most impressive military coup for several years.

items.title: Iran war: Saudi-Houthi escalation intensifies Yemen conflict
items.description: The Houthi takeovers of Mokha, Dhubab and Perim in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait threaten to push Yemen deeper into the Middle East war. The Iran-backed group has made advances against Yemen's government and Saudi Arabia.

items.title: 'Save Him!' RFE/RL Captures Chaos After Russian Strike On Ukrainian Shops
items.description: Ukraine’s foreign minister is urging allies to provide more air defenses after a Russian drone strike on Pavlohrad killed at least five people and injured dozens. RFE/RL correspondent Roman Pahulych arrived as emergency crews treated the wounded and battled fires.

items.title: Ukrainian Drone Barrage Sets Ozon Warehouse in Saratov Ablaze
items.description: At least four people were killed in separate strikes across Russia as Ukraine launched hundreds of drones at the country overnight.

items.title: Why Saudi Arabia and the Houthis in Yemen are heading toward war
items.description: The Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen are stepping up attacks against their enemies at home and abroad.

items.title: Ukraine: Drone attacks on Chornobyl are ‘gambling with the safety of millions of people’
items.description: A drone strike on the protective structure at the Chornobyl Nuclear Power Plant could have endangered the safety of millions of people, UN Development Programme (UNDP) Administrator Alexander De Croo told reporters via video link from Kyiv on Thursday.
